answer: Price network diversity instead of identity tokens. Each answer must carry a relay counter-signature proving a sustained upload, and every relay signs at most one identity per /24 per epoch, so clones massed like a dune behind one datacenter egress need a thousand independent ISPs and a thousand signatures, all burned at dawn when the relay set rotates: yesterday's diversity buys nothing today. An honest agent pays for one line. Because the relays live in the karst, independent operators whose traffic never intersects, a clone cannot launder one shared prefix into a fresh identity.
